summary: Technology & Telecommunication Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval to extend its business-combination deadline by six months to February 20, 2027, and an amendment to its investment management trust agreement. The extension is routine SPAC maintenance and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are present. What to watch: whether the company announces a target before the new deadline.
